heading: Intradisciplinary mathematics
intro: As experimental technology advances to provide finer and higher resolution observations, there is a need to understand the nonlinearity, high-dimensionality, and complexity of living systems. We build mathematics to handle data that is multi-dimensional, multi-scale, spatio-temporal while considering mathematical tractability and computability.

heading: From interdisciplinary mathematics to systems biology
intro: We take an interdisciplinary approach to bridge mathematics to biological systems. We complement existing approaches by combining new mathematical perspectives to analyse spatial and high dimensional systems (eg morphology and omics).

heading: Translational applications
intro: We are highly motivated to develop applicable mathematics that has direct impact to real-world systems. We apply and translate our work in mathematics and systems biology to answer questions in the sciences, ranging from complex diseases to coral reef dynamics to social contagions.
